protocol:
Aggregate V3b C1 (simulation-in-the-loop refinement) into docs/v3b/C1_REFINE_RESULTS.json (validation only).

Arms (same objective/optimizer, same samples): prior (model MAP law + prediction, fixed step 0.5 decade),
prior_sigma (same start, initial step = model predictive std), lawmean_gt (privileged GT law, train mean of
that law), lawmean_best3 (non-privileged: the 3 law means are simulated first, search continues from the
best). Accuracy is reported on the identifiable targets E/rho and sigma_y/rho (train-standardized z of
ln1p specific values; sigma_y only where defined), pooled over (sample, target) elements.
Speedup: smallest number of uninformed simulations whose curve reaches the prior arm's error at k sims
(linear interpolation in log budget), with an object-clustered bootstrap over samples. Start model: best-val-epoch predictions of v2main_C_seed29. Objective (1-IoU)+RGB_MAE_union/255 vs the observed 3-view 128-frame video; compass search over log10(E/rho) [and log10(sigma_y/rho) unless the law is jelly], opportunistic, halving the step after an unsuccessful poll; budget k = best of the first k simulations of one search (nested). nu, rho fixed (prior: predicted; law-mean arms: law train mean); hardening/softening 0.25. Replay = unseen action ACTIONS[(i+3)%6] vs a GT replay. Validation split only; test untouched.

prior_top2.note: budget k counts ALL simulations incl. law probes (prior_top2: 2, lawmean_best3: 3); search_only_accounting relabels each curve by k minus its probes.
